scope: Optional portable art direction. Replace or revise for the current project.

visual_direction.proportions: Stylized anime-inspired proportions chosen for the intended native canvas
visual_direction.shape_language: Clear silhouette and large coherent forms; preserve characteristic ears, tail and costume shapes when present
visual_direction.pixel_craft: Intentional hard-edged clusters; controlled contour and staircase rhythm; selective interior detail
visual_direction.lighting: A consistent single key light with restrained highlights
visual_direction.shading: Usually two or three values per material, adjusted to the design
visual_direction.outline: Dark colored contours when useful; do not force outlines on all assets

content.adult_styling: Any sexualized variant must be explicitly adult with adult visual portrayal; never sexualize a childlike design

animation_defaults.anchor: measure on approved master; do not recenter independently
animation_defaults.source_layer_expectation: truthful flattened layer unless genuinely separated native art is created
